name: checkUTF8
title: Check the validity of a byte stream ot be interpreted as UTF8.

origin.description: checkUTF8 check whether a given raw vector can be used as a valid string encoded in UTF8.
origin.usage: checkUTF8(what, quiet = FALSE, charlen = FALSE, min.char = 1L)

arguments.name: quiet
arguments.text: logical, if TRUE then the function will not fail but report success/failure via its result, otherwise failures are considered errors.

arguments.name: charlen
arguments.text: logical, if TRUE then the function returns the length of the longest byte sequence representing a character in the file.

arguments.name: min.char
arguments.text: integer, any bytes below this value are considered control chacters and reported as errors. The default value of 1L guards against strings including NULs.

origin.value: If charlen=FALSE: TRUE on success, FALSE if the payload is invalid and quite=TRUE. If charlen=TRUE: positive integer corresponding to the longest encoded sequence on success, negative integer on failure.
origin.example:
x <- charToRaw("Hello, 世界")
checkUTF8(x)
checkUTF8(as.raw(c(0xff)), quiet = TRUE)
checkUTF8(x, charlen = TRUE)

translation.description: Return whether a raw byte vector is valid UTF-8, with the same quiet and charlen modes as R.

arguments.name: what
arguments.text: Bytes only. Other types raise invalid input.

arguments.name: quiet
arguments.text: When False, invalid UTF-8 raises ValueError with R's message. When True, invalid input returns False.

arguments.name: charlen
arguments.text: When True, success returns 0 and failure returns the negated max sequence length tracked before the error, as in the C code.

arguments.name: min_char
arguments.text: Bytes strictly below this integer are disallowed control characters when min_char is positive.

translation.value: True or False by default. With charlen=True, an integer: 0 on success or a negative value on failure.
translation.example:
from base64enc.checkUTF8 import checkUTF8
x = "Hello, 世界".encode("utf-8")
print(checkUTF8(x))
print(checkUTF8(bytes([0xFF]), quiet=True))
print(checkUTF8(x, charlen=True))
